stem: Thistledown Analytics wants a name that a parent module can read after a child module finishes running. Which block should the child module declare for that name?
rationale: Output blocks are exactly how a child module exposes a value to whatever calls it. A variable block is an input the parent sets before the child runs, not a way for the child to hand information back. A locals block is confined to the module that defines it and is never visible to a parent module, however useful it is inside the child. A data block reads external information from a provider; it has nothing to do with returning a value up to a caller.
